withdrawnHypothesis: The claim that swapped accounts columns are read correctly before a positional INSERT later swaps debit/credit is withdrawn: ReadContents also uses SELECT * with ordinal reads. No fix was based on that scenario.

confirmedCounterexample.change: voucher_lines adds UNIQUE(summary) ON CONFLICT REPLACE; table names, column order/types/PK/FK stay the same and the extra autoindex has NULL SQL

additionalImplementationFinding: A CR inside -- comment does not end SQLite comment; the first SQL normalizer falsely resurrected an omitted CHECK. .NET bundled SQLite probe confirmed it, and LF-only termination fixed it.

compatibilityControl.change: Only whitespace and closed comments change canonical v1 DDL

policy: Read-only input transaction compares the full restricted SQL token signature and SQLite table/index metadata with a fresh schema from the trusted installed store creator. It does not migrate or rewrite user data.
